name: A New Cloak's Sheen
summary: At Camp Mojache, Krueg Skullsplitter asks you to gather wings for Korrin’s cloak. He came to Feralas with companions sent by their masters in Orgrimmar.

sections.title: A Cloak for Korrin
sections.body: Krueg Skullsplitter came to Feralas with companions sent by their masters in Orgrimmar. His life-mate Korrin loves new clothes, so he plans a cloak adorned with delicate faerie dragon wings. The sprite darters he seeks live west of Camp Mojache. Bring Krueg ten Iridescent Sprite Darter Wings.

sections.title: Krueg's Warning
sections.body: Krueg warns that provoked sprite darters are dangerous. Nearby night elves tend to hole up in the forests, so take even greater care around them.

faq.answer: Krueg Skullsplitter is at Camp Mojache. He came to Feralas with companions sent by their masters in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why does Krueg want sprite darter wings?
faq.answer: Krueg plans a cloak adorned with faerie dragon wings for his life-mate Korrin, who loves new clothes.

faq.q: Where are the sprite darters located?
aliases: where are faerie dragons in feralas
faq.answer: The sprite darters live west of Camp Mojache.

faq.q: What dangers does Krueg warn about?
faq.answer: Sprite darters, which turn dangerous when provoked, and the night elves nearby, who tend to hole up in the forests and call for even greater care.
